updateTo.name: Hoddmimis 0.2.10-beta.1 (build 29)
updateTo.notes:
Privacy mode now hides loaded Inspector file paths, network endpoints, and private security metadata in both the desktop app and TUI.
Importing or deleting a snapshot no longer leaves the TUI stuck on the wrong data source. Settings saves now run outside the UI thread, and shutdown cancels a pending Linux network-service recovery request.
